svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: IoT analytics on Azure subtitle: IoT Hub feeds Stream Analytics and Cosmos DB for the operational app, and Azure Data Explorer for dashboards, alerts and export to the data lake direction: right # Filled triangles, as in Azure's reference diagrams; one port per edge. arrowhead: filled # Compact spacing keeps the four columns inside a README column at full label size. layout: { merge: false, spacing: compact } legend: solid: Telemetry and queries groups: sub: { type: azure:subscription, label: IoT subscription } rg: { type: azure:resource-group, label: rg-iot-analytics, in: sub } nodes: devices: { icon: generic:iot, label: IoT devices, note: "Vehicles, machines, sensors" } iothub: { icon: azure:iot-hub, label: IoT Hub, note: Telemetry and commands, in: rg } # The operational path: a near real-time job keeps device state in Cosmos DB for the app. asa: { icon: azure:stream-analytics-jobs, label: Azure Stream Analytics, note: Near real-time job, in: rg } cosmos: { icon: azure:azure-cosmos-db, label: Azure Cosmos DB, note: JSON device state, in: rg } opsapp: { icon: generic:mobile, label: Operational app, note: "Mobile, web and kiosk" } # The analytical path: Data Explorer ingests the same telemetry through its IoT Hub connector. adx: { icon: azure:azure-data-explorer-clusters, label: Azure Data Explorer, note: Time-series cluster, in: rg } lake: { icon: azure:storage-accounts, label: Data Lake Storage, note: Partitioned Parquet, in: rg } grafana: { icon: azure:azure-managed-grafana, label: Azure Managed Grafana, note: Dashboards, in: rg } alerts: { icon: azure:logic-apps, label: Logic Apps, note: Alerts and notifications, in: rg } # Left out: the Cosmos DB change feed route through Functions to Event Hubs, the alternative to # routing telemetry to Cosmos DB and Data Explorer in parallel. edges: - devices -> iothub: MQTT - iothub -> asa - asa -> cosmos # The app reads Cosmos DB, so its arrow starts at the app. - opsapp -> cosmos: reads - iothub -> adx: data connection - adx -> lake: export # Grafana and the Logic Apps connector both query Data Explorer; the arrowheads stay on it. - { from: adx, to: grafana, arrow: start, label: KQL } - { from: adx, to: alerts, arrow: start }

svg.title: IoT analytics on Azure
svg.desc: IoT analytics on Azure. 9 components in 2 groups. Connections: IoT devices to IoT Hub (MQTT); IoT Hub to Azure Stream Analytics; Azure Stream Analytics to Azure Cosmos DB; Operational app to Azure Cosmos DB (reads); IoT Hub to Azure Data Explorer (data connection); Azure Data Explorer to Data Lake Storage (export); Azure Data Explorer to Azure Managed Grafana (KQL); Azure Data Explorer to Logic Apps.

text.tspan: IoT Hub feeds Stream Analytics and Cosmos DB for the operational app, and Azure Data Explorer for dashboards, alerts and export to the data lake
